description.value:
Supposedly once owned by Brick, the former leader of the Maelstrom gang. Shocker.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 2,500eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Shotgun Rechamber, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon can load Non-Basic Ammunition. Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. When this weapon is fired, it expends both loaded rounds at once. It cannot be fired in the same Round its Tech Rebuild is charged in. While charged, it also deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6 Slug / 5d6 Shell) and has all fired ammunition also apply the effect of EMP Ammunition in addition to its regular damage and other effects.

Fabrication: DV29 - 2,500eb - 1 Month
Range: Shotgun
Pre-installed: Shotgun Rechamber, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
